title: Tonkotsu Ramen for the Crew
seoTitle: Tonkotsu Ramen for the Crew | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Rich pork-and-chicken broth with noodles and toppings for ten
subtitle: Rich pork-and-chicken broth with noodles and toppings for ten
description: Pork bones and chicken backs simmer for hours into a creamy white broth, then serve over springy ramen noodles with chashu pork, soft eggs, nori, and scallions. Set up a topping bar so crews build their own bowls.

steps.title: Blanch and start broth
steps.instruction: Blanch pork and chicken bones 5 minutes, rinse, then cover with fresh water in a large stockpot. Add ginger and garlic. Simmer vigorously 4 hours, skimming often.

steps.title: Braise chashu pork
steps.instruction: Roll pork belly, tie, and braise in soy, mirin, and water 2 hours until tender. Cool and slice thin.

steps.title: Season the broth
steps.instruction: Strain broth if you want smoother body. Whisk soy and mirin tare into broth to taste—salty, rich, and milky white.

steps.title: Prep the bar
steps.instruction: Arrange chashu, eggs, nori, scallions, and corn in labeled pans. Heat broth to a rolling simmer in a large pot or tilt skillet.

steps.title: Build bowls
steps.instruction: Cook noodles per package, drain, and divide into bowls. Ladle hot broth over noodles, top with chashu and garnishes, and serve immediately.

proTips: A tablespoon of chicken fat whisked in at service adds extra gloss.
Do not add noodles to the hold pot—they swell and ruin texture.
Sesame seeds and bamboo shoots upgrade the bar without much extra work.
tonightSpread: Tonkotsu ramen bowls with full topping bar and chili oil.
Quick cucumber pickles for crunch between rich sips.
leftovers: Broth freezes well for a second ramen night later in the month.
Chashu slices reheat gently in broth for rice topping—not a bowl format, just smart reuse.
whyCrewsLikeIt: Ramen night feels like a reward shift. The broth does the heavy lifting overnight, and bowl service moves fast when noodles and toppings are lined up like a firehouse assembly station.
mealPrepNotes: Start broth the day before. Blanch bones first for cleaner flavor. Soft-boil eggs 6.5 minutes, ice bath, peel ahead. Cook noodles to order or in small batches so they do not turn mushy.
